title: CheckMyCoach: A Four-Module Intervention Prototype and Bounded Offline Evaluation

abstract: This system note describes a four-module intervention prototype and one bounded execution on a fixed 40-case constructed fitness-advice corpus. The pipeline routed 15 cases, generated candidate revisions for routed cases, and removed the predefined target feature in 12 delivered outputs; none passed every target-and-retention check. These are implementation and execution facts, not validated detection, repair effectiveness, human benefit, or cross-domain evidence.
